tagline: Check it. Practise against it. Protect your family.

home.sub: Paste any suspicious message and Kavach tells you if it is a scam, why, and what to do next. Then practise against a safe AI scammer so the real one never works.
home.guardian: Looking after a parent or grandparent?

check.title: Check
check.body: Paste a message or a screenshot. Get a plain-language verdict in seconds, not jargon.

drill.title: Fire Drill
drill.body: Face a safe AI scammer for a few turns. Get coached on the cues you caught and missed.

family.title: Family Loop
family.body: One tap tells someone who cares, with a summary and a call button.

home.statBody: Practising against weakened scam attempts builds resistance that reading tips alone does not.
home.boosterDue: It has been a week — a quick drill keeps it sharp.
home.demoCaption: A real scam message, analysed live by the same endpoint the app uses.
home.proofLabel: Measured on our own test set
home.how1b: We mask OTPs and numbers before anything leaves your phone.
home.how2b: A verdict, the tactics used, and what to do right now.
home.how3b: One tap sends a summary to someone who can help.
home.tacticsLabel: It names the trick, not just the message
home.tacticsBody: Every verdict tags the manipulation tactics used, drawn from Stajano and Wilson's seven principles of scam victimisation.
home.researchBody: The Fire Drill is inoculation theory: practising against weakened attacks builds resistance that reading advice does not.
home.ctaTitle: One call is all it takes.
home.ctaBody: Check a message now, or practise so the real one never works.

check.title: Is this message a scam?
check.sub: Paste the message below. We mask phone numbers and codes before analysing it.
check.placeholder: Paste the suspicious SMS, WhatsApp message or email here...
check.helpline: For real fraud, call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in
check.disclaimer: Kavach is advisory and can be wrong. When in doubt, contact your bank on the number printed on your card.
check.fallbackNote: Checked with offline rules because the AI service was unavailable.
check.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

drill.title: Fire Drill
drill.sub: Practise against a safe AI scammer. Nothing here is real, and nothing you type is stored.
drill.scenarioHint: One of these is a genuine call. Can you tell which?
drill.hangUp: Hang up and see my score
drill.safetyNote: Never type a real OTP, card number or address, even in a drill.
drill.scoringSub: Reading your replies and checking them against the warning signs for this scenario.

family.title: Family dashboard
family.sub: Alerts raised by the people you look after.
family.none: No alerts yet. That is good news.

helper.title: Helper mode
helper.sub: Your aunt is about to send 50,000 rupees to a scammer. Talk her out of it.
helper.belief: How sure she is it is real
helper.placeholder: What do you say to her?
helper.savedBody: She hung up and called her son instead. That is exactly how a family loop is supposed to work.
helper.lostBody: It is hard, and it is not your fault. Look at what moved her and try again.
helper.hint: Tip: give her a way to check for herself, and never make her feel foolish.
helper.whyBody: Research on role-based fraud training found that persuading someone else out of a scam improves your own ability to spot one as much as being the target does.
